dataset_meta.source: IP102 & ICAR Tropical Pest Diagnostic Benchmark

species.name: Fall Armyworm
species.symptoms: Ragged holes in leaves, excessive sawdust-like frass in leaf whorls, damaged cobs.
species.ipm_remedy: Apply Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE 5%) or Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt @ 2g/L). Release egg parasitoids Trichogramma pretiosum @ 50,000/acre. In acute infestation, spray Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4g/L.

species.name: Brown Planthopper
species.symptoms: Hopper burn: Circular patches of dried, brownish-yellow plants resembling fire burn.
species.ipm_remedy: Drain field water for 3-4 days (Alternate Wetting and Drying). Avoid excessive urea. Spray Azadirachtin 1500 ppm @ 2.5 ml/L or Pymetrozine 50% WDG @ 0.6g/L.

species.name: Yellow Stem Borer
species.symptoms: Dead hearts in vegetative stage and white ears (chaffy panicles) in reproductive stage.
species.ipm_remedy: Clip seedling tips before transplanting. Set up light/pheromone traps @ 5/ha. Release Trichogramma japonicum @ 100,000/ha.

species.name: Cotton Pink Bollworm
species.symptoms: Rosetted flowers, bore holes plugged with excreta on bolls, stained lint.
species.ipm_remedy: Install Pheromone traps with Gossyplure @ 10/acre. Release Bracon hebetor. Apply neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 1 ml/L.

species.name: Gram Pod Borer
species.symptoms: Round feeding holes on pods/fruits with half of larval body protruding outside.
species.ipm_remedy: Install bird perches @ 20/acre. Spray HaNPV (Nuclear Polyhedrosis Virus) @ 250 LE/ha or Beauveria bassiana @ 5g/L.

species.name: Cotton Whitefly
species.symptoms: Yellowing and curling of leaves, sticky honeydew secretion promoting black sooty mold.
species.ipm_remedy: Install yellow sticky traps @ 15-20/acre. Spray 5% Neem seed oil or spray fungal pathogen Verticillium lecanii @ 5g/L.
